title: Super Mario Odyssey: Seashine Island
author: mariofan235
description:
Welcome to SUPER MARIO ODYSSEY SEASHINE ISLAND! A 2D retro imagining of Super Mario Odyssey! During their summer travels, Mario & Cappy have found a mysterious, tranquil island filled with secrets and surprises. Can you find all 20 Power Moons and/or 50 Purple Coins?

CONTROLS
-Left/Right Arrow Keys to move
-X to Jump
-Z to throw Cappy or carry items
-Down key to duck
-C to un-capture objects
-Up arrow to look up/throw items upward
-P to access the Pause Menu
